packs.title: Gorge to Lake
packs.promise: Explore U.S. side stories from the Niagara Gorge through Lewiston to Lake Ontario.

q.s: Look for a fin, body shape or movement that suits each habitat
st: At the Aquarium Main Building, choose two distinct animal habitats.
Look for a fin, body shape or movement that suits each habitat.
Write one comparison that uses the animals’ visible traits rather than a display headline.

q.s: Identify a choice, risk or act of help in that account without photographing sensitive displays
st: Inside the Heritage Center, choose one person’s account in the permanent exhibition.
Identify a choice, risk or act of help in that account without photographing sensitive displays.
Write two respectful sentences about what the Niagara River meant in that story.

q.s: Find one outdoor sculpture or art installation without leaving the path
st: Take an open upper Artpark trail in daylight.
Find one outdoor sculpture or art installation without leaving the path.
Compare one material or shape in the artwork with a nearby tree, slope or river view.

packs.title: Between River & Brink
packs.promise: Explore the connected U.S. side State Park paths from Prospect Point to Goat Island.

q.s: Find a near, middle and far layer: railing or trees, falling water, then gorge wall
st: Stand at an open Prospect Point railing with the American Falls in view.
Find a near, middle and far layer: railing or trees, falling water, then gorge wall.
Write one sentence about how your eye travels through those three layers.

q.s: Watch water split around an island edge or bridge support without leaning outward
st: Pause on an open Green Island pedestrian crossing, safely behind its rail.
Watch water split around an island edge or bridge support without leaning outward.
Describe how a smooth patch and a broken, fast-moving patch differ.

q.s: Trace the visible Horseshoe Falls curve with three lines in a notebook
st: Use an open public railing at Terrapin Point.
Trace the visible Horseshoe Falls curve with three lines in a notebook.
